definitions.explanation: A padded bag designed for sleeping in, typically used for camping, hiking, or emergency situations. Provides insulation and protection from the elements.

examples.japanese: キャンプには{寝袋|ねぶくろ}を{持|も}っていく。
examples.english: I bring a sleeping bag when camping.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}い{夜|よる}でも{寝袋|ねぶくろ}があれば{暖|あたた}かい。
examples.english: Even on cold nights, a sleeping bag keeps you warm.

examples.japanese: {災害用|さいがいよう}に{寝袋|ねぶくろ}を{準備|じゅんび}しておいた。
examples.english: I prepared a sleeping bag for disaster preparedness.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{寝|ね} (sleep) + {袋|ふくろ/ぶくろ} (bag). The reading {袋|ぶくろ} is a voiced compound form.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{寝袋|ねぶくろ}に{入|はい}る - to get into a sleeping bag
・{寝袋|ねぶくろ}を{広|ひろ}げる - to spread out a sleeping bag
・{寝袋|ねぶくろ}を{畳|たた}む - to fold up a sleeping bag
・{封筒型|ふうとうがた}{寝袋|ねぶくろ} - rectangular sleeping bag
・マミー{型|がた}{寝袋|ねぶくろ} - mummy-style sleeping bag

ALSO CALLED:
シュラフ (from German "Schlafsack") is also commonly used, especially among experienced campers.
